correctness.rationale: Rotational Gaussian invariance makes W=||Pi_b v||² independent Beta(q/2,p/2), while the orthogonal split Av=(a+Delta W)v+Delta sqrt(W(1-W))u gives independent Gaussian Sv,Su. Hence lambda_hat=a+Delta[W+sqrt(W(1-W)) Z/chi_k] with independent ratio. The square of the Student ratio transformed to T=U²/(1+U²) is Beta(1/2,k/2). Escape is exactly W<T or 1-W<T according to ratio sign, proving the two incomplete-beta integrals and P(k=1)=1/2. Small-t incomplete-beta and exact beta moments yield escape k^(-r/2) with r=min(p,q) and the stated sharp constant; corresponding scaled overshoot integral yields k^(-r/2-1). The one-sided Student tail and beta moment give the fixed-k t^(-k) overshoot tail with positive constant and moment cutoff s<k. The p=q=1 planar angular integral gives P(k=2)=1-2/pi and EH/Delta=2/pi-1/2. Independent Student-ratio integration reproduced P(k=1,2,3,5)=(.5,.363380227632,.297357632715,.229810176954), corroborating the k=2 closed form.
